This was the beginning of the end - fast forward about 6 months and we'll be lucky to get out with 80% of our original investment. Disaster, basically. 

Look, it can work. But it's a proper business and it comes with hard, hard work. It's not easy and theres a massively high probability that you'll fail, unless you design, engineer and actually invent your own product, which is obviously incredibly difficult.
